# openinfra_directory (Resource)

A Samba Active Directory domain controller — the AWS Managed Microsoft AD-shaped primitive. Machines join it manually; see the open-infra docs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain FQDN, lowercase, e.g. `corp.example.lan`. The Kerberos realm and NetBIOS name are derived from it, so it cannot be changed in place.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `expose` (Boolean) Get a LAN IP for DNS, Kerberos, LDAP and SMB so machines can join.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `size` (String) Storage for the directory database.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
